DCON.description: RC Design Code (DCON). A single global record (key must be 1) that sets the reinforced-concrete design code; DGNCODE names the code and drives all RC design defaults.

DGNCODE.description: Reinforced-concrete design code name. Validated at runtime against the RC design-code list (CLoadDgnCodeChecker, eDgnRC); an unrecognized value is rejected. Example: "KCI-USD12".
